info.name: Skjalf Search
info.summary: AI-powered semantic image search for Nextcloud
info.description:
# Skjalf Search
A Nextcloud app that provides AI-powered semantic search for images stored in your Nextcloud instance.
## Features
- **Automatic Ingestion**: Monitor folders for new images and automatically generate embeddings - **Semantic Search**: Search images by natural language queries (e.g., "sunset at the beach") - **Smart Thumbnails**: Generate and cache thumbnails for faster browsing - **Real-time Updates**: Instant embedding when new files are uploaded
## Architecture
The app uses a Python embedder service to generate vector embeddings from image content, storing them in ChromaDB for fast semantic retrieval.
